create_full_resolution_voxel_grid: create a FullResolutionVoxelGrid with configurable resolution changes and trilinear interpolation for 3D feature lookup
create_cp_factorized_voxel_grid: create a CPFactorizedVoxelGrid using CANDECOMP PARAFAC factorization with three vector components for memory efficient 3D grids
create_vm_factorized_voxel_grid: create a VMFactorizedVoxelGrid using Vector Matrix factorization with three matrices and three vectors from TensoRF
create_trainable_voxel_grid_module: create a VoxelGridModule wrapper that holds voxel grid parameters as trainable PyTorch parameters or registered buffers
change_voxel_grid_resolution: change the resolution of voxel grid values at specific training epochs using linear or bicubic interpolation
